import os

os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)

# Write "one" (overwrite/create)
with open("./out/app.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("one")

# Separate append operation for "two"
with open("./out/app.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("two")

# Read back and write contents plus a single newline
with open("./out/app.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    contents = f.read()

with open("./out/answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(contents + "\n")

raise SystemExit(0)
